editorial_note: Underdots mark uncertain letters in the published reading; brackets mark lost text. Line rectangles were fitted to the published image and checked by eye; they are not CT coordinates. Line 9 begins after the image ends and is not shown. Starting translations are unreviewed Muse Spark drafts, not a scholarly translation.

en.text: are considered, pertaining to each of the criteria. But with respect to those having neither to say anything in general about pleasure nor about the particular, when something determinate, but nevertheless
en.review_status: Unreviewed model draft; not a scholarly reading. Underdots denote uncertain readings on the initial letter of hekastes, on the letters of kata meros, and on the initial vowel of hote. No square brackets, round brackets, or question marks occur in the passage as supplied. The hyphen after ho marks a line break. The neither-nor negation and the general versus in-particular contrast are preserved, and the final alla oun is left incomplete without supplying missing words.

ta.text: அவை ஒவ்வொரு அளவுகோலுக்கும் உரியனவாகப் பரிசீலிக்கப்படுகின்றன. ஆனால் இன்பம் பற்றிப் பொதுவாக எதையும் சொல்வதற்கும் இல்லாதவர்களைப் பொறுத்தும், குறிப்பானது பற்றிச் சொல்வதற்கும் இல்லாதவர்களைப் பொறுத்தும், ஏதோ ஒன்று வரையறுக்கப்பட்டதாக இருக்கும்போது, ஆனால் எனினும்
